result.title: Vertically Integrated, Horizontally Open | AI Factory Insider Ep 5
result.description:
How can an AI platform be optimized from hardware to software while staying open to developers and partners at every layer?

In Episode 5 of AI Factory Insider, host Kaushik Shirhatti (VP, AI Factory, NVIDIA) is joined by Pradeep Gupta (VP, Industries Solutions Architecture, NVIDIA) and Stephen Jones (CUDA Architect, NVIDIA) to discuss how vertical integration works with an open ecosystem, how CUDA-X libraries serve specialized industry workloads, and how agent skills are changing software development.

What we cover:
0:00 — Introduction
1:08 — Meet Pradeep Gupta and Stephen Jones
1:28 — What does "vertically integrated, horizontally open" mean?
3:25 — One platform, many industries
4:30 — AI across healthcare, retail, and finance
6:35 — What stays common across industries
8:55 — CUDA: the link from apps to GPUs
10:29 — CUDA's early days and the first debugger
13:24 — The spreadsheet behind CUDA profiling
14:24 — CUDA vs. CUDA-X libraries
16:08 — Identifying the right CUDA-X library for your use case
17:42 — How is CUDA open if it runs on NVIDIA GPUs?
21:33 — CUDA-X in finance, biopharma, and smart cities
22:50 — How CUDA libraries build on each other
25:18 — CUDA and GPU hardware co-design
28:05 — Reuse the core; specialize when needed
29:15 — Agents need tools and skills
31:01 — CUDA-X libraries as agent skills
32:59 — How AI agents change the way developer work
37:15 — Wrap-up

result.title: 10 Years of NVIDIA DGX
result.description:
Ten years ago at NVIDIA GTC 2016, our CEO Jensen Huang introduced DGX-1, our first AI supercomputer.

Since then, NVIDIA DGX has transformed from a single system into a blueprint for AI factories. What hasn’t changed is the reason why we build DGX: to test the systems and work through the details of interconnects, cooling, and software so our partners and customers have a proven foundation to build on.

Charlie Boyle, our VP of DGX Systems, looks back at how DGX got its start, what’s changed, and what comes next.

Thanks to everyone who’s been on this journey with us. #DecadeOfDGX

result.title: 10 Years of NVIDIA DGX: From One System to AI Factories
result.description:
A decade ago, Jensen Huang introduced DGX-1 to help researchers tackle AI challenges once thought out of reach. He delivered the first DGX-1 to OpenAI, which started the AI revolution. 
What began as a single system has evolved into the blueprint for the modern AI factory—driving breakthroughs across research, medicine, industry and beyond.

Thank you to every researcher, developer, partner and customer who has shared this journey. Here’s to the next decade of NVIDIA DGX.
